## Change

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run coverage` (the tests, held to the coverage floors)
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run site-check -- popup`, if the popup changed
- [ ] CI passes against the latest `main`.

## Privacy and documentation

- [ ] Changes contain only synthetic data; no records, exports, credentials, tokens or HAR files.
- [ ] User documentation and policy copies are updated where affected.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for visible changes, using synthetic data.
